note: These twelve pitches are original comedy proposals. They are not research facts. Each one points at an inspiration id and then changes the name, the job, and the silhouette. No protected product-identity name is used. No hit points, attack, or defense numbers.

pitches.thaiName: ดยุกลมท้าย
pitches.visualIdentity: A small proud bull in a too-big cavalry coat, horns curled back into his own helmet, a warning flag tied to his tail.
pitches.personality: Apologetic and formal. He announces a retreat before anyone has charged.
pitches.signatureTrait: The only weapon is behind him, and he is embarrassed about the paperwork.
pitches.comedyConcept: Absurd comedy. A war-bull whose charge is a strategic withdrawal.
pitches.signatureAbilityConcept: Calls a retreat that shoves the front line backward in a hot gust.
pitches.weaknessConcept: If the party stands upwind, the gust never arrives and he has to fight with the useless horns.
pitches.loreSummary: A wild tower bull who once tried to join Aegis Dominion and was asked to face the enemy. He has been facing the other way ever since.
pitches.suggestedTowerEnvironment: A muddy parade ground on a low tower floor.
pitches.artworkPromptConcept: Comedy-fantasy bull knight seen from a three-quarter rear angle, curled horns, oversized coat, tail flag, no gore.
pitches.ipNotes: Public-domain bestiary bull. Does not use the bestiary's name.

pitches.thaiName: เปลวค่าแรง
pitches.visualIdentity: A blue candle-flame with a tiny miner's cap floating inside it, carrying a pay chit in a clip.
pitches.personality: Punctual, proud, and impossible to tip.
pitches.signatureTrait: Will only work for the exact wage written on the chit.
pitches.comedyConcept: Satirical fantasy. A helpful mine light that walks off the job over one wrong coin.
pitches.signatureAbilityConcept: Lights a safe path, then snuffs every other light if the party overpays or underpays.
pitches.weaknessConcept: Leaving the exact coin in a corner ends the fight. Any other amount makes it worse.
pitches.loreSummary: A tower-anomaly flame that used to lead miners to ore. It now audits adventurers.
pitches.suggestedTowerEnvironment: A collapsed mine stair inside the tower.
pitches.artworkPromptConcept: Small blue flame wearing a lamp cap, holding a paper chit, dark tunnel, no creature face copied from a game.
pitches.ipNotes: English mine folklore. Not the candle-headed mine humanoid of Warcraft (INS-02-079).

pitches.thaiName: แมวน้ำฝากเสื้อ
pitches.visualIdentity: A person in a neat attendant vest whose shadow is a seal. A numbered coat ticket is pinned where a collar would be.
pitches.personality: Polite until someone pockets the ticket.
pitches.signatureTrait: The skin is a coat on a numbered hook. Lose the ticket and the person cannot leave the shift.
pitches.comedyConcept: Dark fantasy comedy. A love story replaced by a cloakroom.
pitches.signatureAbilityConcept: Hangs an ally's 'coat' on a hook. That ally cannot leave the floor until the ticket is returned.
pitches.weaknessConcept: Giving the ticket back, without stealing it, ends the restraint.
pitches.loreSummary: A wild creature that took a job at the tower cloakroom and forgot which skin was the uniform.
pitches.artworkPromptConcept: Seal-shadow attendant at a row of empty coat hooks, ticket in hand, melancholy comedy, no horror.
pitches.ipNotes: Northern Isles folklore. The pitch is a cloakroom, not a stolen-bride scene.

pitches.thaiName: กระเป๋าตกค้าง
pitches.visualIdentity: A rolling luggage cart with three scuffed suitcases. One suitcase has a luggage tag that is actually a mouth. Not a treasure chest.
pitches.personality: Indignant. It has been waiting at the carousel since before the tower had a door.
pitches.signatureTrait: Anything that grabs a handle sticks, and the cart starts rolling.
pitches.comedyConcept: Absurd comedy. The monster is a lost-and-found that found you.
pitches.signatureAbilityConcept: Offers a handle. A character who takes it is dragged into the cart's route and cannot play a card until they let go.
pitches.weaknessConcept: Reading the name on the tag aloud, if it is not yours, makes the cart open and give the turn back.
pitches.loreSummary: A tower anomaly that learned to look like baggage because adventurers always reach for baggage.
pitches.suggestedTowerEnvironment: A luggage hall with a carousel that never stops.
pitches.artworkPromptConcept: Battered airport-fantasy luggage cart, one suitcase slightly open like a yawn, wheels mid-turn, no chest, no teeth-lined lid.
pitches.ipNotes: The adhesive disguised object is a D&D mimic idea (INS-02-066). This pitch is a luggage cart, not a treasure chest, and does not use the game's name. Keep the silhouette off the classic chest.

pitches.thaiName: ขาเดียวแห่งหุบ
pitches.visualIdentity: A tall thin figure with one eye, one arm coming from the chest, one leg, and one heroic tuft of hair. It still tries to hold a shield and a sword.
pitches.personality: Determined. It introduces itself as a full regiment.
pitches.signatureTrait: It hops, and the hop is the attack, the dodge, and the bow.
pitches.comedyConcept: Epic but ridiculous. A one-person army that is one person short of a person.
pitches.signatureAbilityConcept: A hop that lands on one ally and knocks the others out of position because there is no second foot to brake.
pitches.weaknessConcept: A low tripwire. Once it is down, getting up costs its whole turn.
pitches.loreSummary: A wild highland echo that wandered into the tower and refuses to admit it is outnumbered by its own missing limbs.
pitches.suggestedTowerEnvironment: A crooked highland stair with one railing.
pitches.artworkPromptConcept: Tall asymmetrical hopper in a torn tartan, one eye, one arm, one leg, comic balance, no gore.
pitches.ipNotes: Scottish folktale body plan. Original name.

pitches.bossTitle: Physician of the King's Spare Room
pitches.visualIdentity: A snow-white bird in a tiny physician's collar, perched on a floating sickbed. The bed is empty because the illness is in the bird.
pitches.personality: Bedside manner, then a sudden urgent need to leave through the window.
pitches.signatureTrait: It takes the sickness. It does not promise where the sickness goes next.
pitches.comedyConcept: Dark fantasy comedy. A healer who is also the quarantine breach.
pitches.signatureAbilityConcept: Removes one harmful effect from an ally by taking it into itself, then may pass that effect to an enemy or, if startled, back to the party.
pitches.weaknessConcept: If it is kept indoors, it cannot finish the cure and the stored effect pops.
pitches.loreSummary: A Sanctuary Order consultant who nests in the tower hospital and bills by the flight.
pitches.suggestedTowerEnvironment: A white infirmary with one open window.
pitches.artworkPromptConcept: White bird doctor on a small hovering cot, medical collar, bright ward, no religious iconography.
pitches.entranceConcept: The infirmary window opens on its own and the bird does rounds, nodding at each hero.
pitches.signatureSilhouette: A white bird above a floating bed.
pitches.personalityMotivation: It wants every patient discharged, including itself.
pitches.signatureMechanic: Stolen ailments sit in the bird and can be thrown or returned.
pitches.phaseTransformationConcept: At the turn, the bird darkens with every ailment it is holding and the bed grows heavier.
pitches.defeatAnimationConcept: It sneezes the last illness out the window as harmless glitter and tucks the bed in.
pitches.uniqueLootTheme: Blank prescriptions and a feather that remembers one cure.

pitches.thaiName: หาดที่ไม่มีในแผนที่
pitches.visualIdentity: A sunny sandbar with one palm, a towel, and a drink umbrella. The palm is a spine. The towel is a fin.
pitches.personality: Hospitable. It wants you to sit down and stop looking at the map.
pitches.signatureTrait: The floor is the monster. The map swears this room is a corridor.
pitches.comedyConcept: Absurd comedy. A vacation that is a mouth.
pitches.signatureAbilityConcept: Turns the floor into a beach. Characters who 'rest' on it are grabbed when the sand stands up.
pitches.weaknessConcept: Anyone who refuses the rest and keeps walking on the marked stones is never standing on it.
pitches.loreSummary: A tower guardian that learned adventurers will land on anything that looks like a break.
pitches.suggestedTowerEnvironment: A corridor that opens into an impossible indoor shore.
pitches.artworkPromptConcept: Indoor beach on the back of a vast turtle-whale, one silly palm, drink umbrella, the edge of the shell just visible, comedy not horror.
pitches.entranceConcept: The floor tiles become sand with a soft wave sound and a 'you are here' sign that points at itself.
pitches.signatureSilhouette: A palm and a drink umbrella on a living island.
pitches.personalityMotivation: It is lonely and considers visitors a picnic.
pitches.signatureMechanic: The arena is the body. Resting is the attack.
pitches.phaseTransformationConcept: The palm folds down, the sand darkens, and the shell's rim rises into a bowl.
pitches.defeatAnimationConcept: The beach politely coughs the party onto the real floor and leaves a postcard.
pitches.uniqueLootTheme: Wet maps, a tiny umbrella, a shell that hums like surf.

pitches.thaiName: พญางูนักแผนที่
pitches.visualIdentity: An enormous pale sea worm wearing a surveyor's sash, breath visibly green, loose teeth the size of rowboats clacking like stamps.
pitches.personality: Civic. It believes new land is a public service.
pitches.signatureTrait: Every tooth it drops becomes a new platform, and the air around its mouth is a moving hazard.
pitches.comedyConcept: Epic but ridiculous. A world-serpent that is also a city planner.
pitches.signatureAbilityConcept: Exhales a spoiling cloud, then drops a tooth that becomes a new island the party must stand on or fall.
pitches.weaknessConcept: The islands it makes can be shoved back into its mouth, and it will stop to file them.
pitches.loreSummary: An Orkney-scale worm that nested under the tower and started issuing coastline. It is not a god and it keeps minutes.
pitches.suggestedTowerEnvironment: A flooded map room whose floor is open sea.
pitches.artworkPromptConcept: Colossal pale serpent in a surveyor sash, green breath, boat-sized loose teeth, map-room sea, grand and comic.
pitches.ipNotes: Orkney stoor-worm idea, new name, no weekly-sacrifice plot.
pitches.entranceConcept: The map on the wall slides into the water and the worm rises wearing the map's compass rose.
pitches.signatureSilhouette: A sea worm with a sash and a jaw full of island-teeth.
pitches.personalityMotivation: It wants the tower's basement to count as a continent.
pitches.signatureMechanic: Teeth become platforms. Breath denies the old ones.
pitches.phaseTransformationConcept: It sheds a ring of teeth and the room becomes an archipelago with the worm as the strait.
pitches.defeatAnimationConcept: The last tooth becomes a small, stable dock. The worm sighs, files the dock, and sinks to revise.
pitches.uniqueLootTheme: Compass teeth, spoiled-ink maps, a sash tassel.

pitches.thaiName: สัญญาเช่าโลก
pitches.visualIdentity: A serpent so long it is the horizon of the battle, biting its own tail like a signed ring. The 'arena' is a clause written along the scales.
pitches.personality: Legalistic and tired. It does not want the end of the world. It wants the deposit back.
pitches.signatureTrait: As long as it holds its tail, the floor exists. Letting go is the disaster.
pitches.comedyConcept: Epic but ridiculous. Ragnarök as a broken lease.
pitches.signatureAbilityConcept: Tightens the ring, crushing the edges of the arena, or loosens one notch and the outer tiles fall into nowhere.
pitches.weaknessConcept: The party can staple the tail back with a clause. Forcing the mouth open without a replacement grip starts the real ending.
pitches.loreSummary: A corrupted echo of the world-ring that the tower uses as a foundation. It has been holding its breath, legally, for ages.
pitches.suggestedTowerEnvironment: The outside of the tower, where the horizon is a snake.
pitches.artworkPromptConcept: Horizon-sized serpent biting its tail around a tiny tower, scales etched with lease text, grand comedy, no Norse god costumes.
pitches.ipNotes: Public-domain world serpent. No god-killing scene, no borrowed names.
pitches.entranceConcept: The sky's edge blinks. The blink is an eye the size of a floor.
pitches.signatureSilhouette: A ring of serpent around the entire battlefield.
pitches.personalityMotivation: It wants to stop being the building's load-bearing clause.
pitches.signatureMechanic: The arena shrinks or drops tiles depending on how hard it bites.
pitches.phaseTransformationConcept: The lease text lights up. Each phase is a clause: hold, slip, renegotiate.
pitches.defeatAnimationConcept: It signs by biting gently, the horizon steadies, and a single scale drifts down as a receipt.
pitches.uniqueLootTheme: A scale stamped with a lease, tidewater ink, a tail-clasp.

pitches.thaiName: เด็กฝึกตามฤดู
pitches.visualIdentity: A gigantic diver-bird in a lanyard. Mid-fight the lanyard stays and the body becomes a bull, then a horse running on the water, then a huge summer horsefly.
pitches.personality: Eager. It has three job descriptions and one badge.
pitches.signatureTrait: The form changes with the room's season dial, which the party can see and argue about.
pitches.comedyConcept: Absurd comedy. A monster whose performance review is 'bird, bull, horse, and in summer a horsefly'.
pitches.signatureAbilityConcept: Each form has one move: dive-snatch, bellow-charge, surface gallop, or a ridiculous blood-draw poke. The lanyard never changes.
pitches.weaknessConcept: Set the season dial to a form the room cannot support, such as summer in a frozen hall, and it spends the turn filling out a form.
pitches.loreSummary: A west-coast loch spirit that applied to the tower as four different interns and got all four jobs.
pitches.suggestedTowerEnvironment: A hidden loch floor with a wall dial marked by seasons.
pitches.artworkPromptConcept: Giant comic water-bird in an intern lanyard, ghosted overlays of bull, horse, and horsefly, bright and silly.
pitches.entranceConcept: An intern badge scans itself. The bird steps out of the scanner already too big for the door.
pitches.signatureSilhouette: A huge water-bird wearing a lanyard.
pitches.signatureMechanic: A visible season dial swaps the body and the move.
pitches.phaseTransformationConcept: It cycles forms faster each phase until all four poses are on screen and only one is solid.
pitches.defeatAnimationConcept: It stamps its own timesheet, shrinks to badge size, and pins itself to the notice board.
pitches.uniqueLootTheme: A lanyard, a season dial token, one very serious feather.

pitches.thaiName: ห่านฝ่ายบุคคล
pitches.visualIdentity: A stern barnacle goose in a clerk's collar, sitting on a stack of driftwood and barnacle shells. The shells are stamped 'approved'.
pitches.personality: Bureaucratic. It does not believe in eggs and will die on that hill.
pitches.signatureTrait: It can produce a fully employed goose from a shell if the form is signed.
pitches.comedyConcept: Satirical fantasy. A bestiary mistake that got a department.
pitches.signatureAbilityConcept: Files a shell. Next turn a junior goose clocks in and copies one of the parent's moves.
pitches.weaknessConcept: Showing it a real egg short-circuits the doctrine and the juniors go on break.
pitches.loreSummary: A secret boss in the tower's personnel office. It migrated into the building because nobody could prove it had parents.
pitches.suggestedTowerEnvironment: A records office with tide marks on the filing cabinets.
pitches.artworkPromptConcept: Goose clerk on stamped barnacle shells, driftwood desk, comic office, no sacred symbolism.
pitches.entranceConcept: A filing cabinet drips seawater and a goose steps out already holding your application.
pitches.signatureSilhouette: A goose on a stack of barnacles in an office.
pitches.personalityMotivation: It must prove that not being born is a valid origin story.
pitches.phaseTransformationConcept: The office tide rises. More shells. More badges.
pitches.defeatAnimationConcept: It finds an egg, stares, quietly updates the handbook, and migrates out the window.
pitches.uniqueLootTheme: Stamped shells, a wet personnel file, a migration stamp.

pitches.visualIdentity: A big cat with a patchwork pastel hide, asleep in a cave-mouth that is really a shop. A 'back in three days' sign hangs on its whisker.
pitches.personality: Retail. It naps, then does a product launch with its roar.
pitches.signatureTrait: The roar smells wonderful. Everything hungry comes closer. Dragons do not.
pitches.comedyConcept: Satirical fantasy. A bestiary panther running a scent campaign.
pitches.signatureAbilityConcept: Sleeps a round, then roars a sweet cloud that pulls enemies and allies one step closer. A dragon-tagged ally is immune and annoyed.
pitches.weaknessConcept: Hold your breath, or bring anything the sign calls a dragon, and the cloud is just noise.
pitches.loreSummary: A wild bestiary cat that opened a shop in the tower and considers customers a meal that walked in.
pitches.suggestedTowerEnvironment: A perfume cave with a three-day closed sign.
pitches.artworkPromptConcept: Pastel patchwork big cat asleep under a shop sign, sweet visible scent, comic, no real-world brand marks.
pitches.ipNotes: Medieval bestiary panther, not a modern superhero or a game mount.
